Common questions
How does the Pay-As-You-Go plan work?

The Pay-As-You-Go plan offers rapid access to our cloud offering of Tonic Structural, making it ideal for simple use cases and small data sizes. The plan entails a monthly credit card subscription that is billed automatically and includes up to 20 unique tables processed per month, as many times as you need. If you exceed 20 unique tables, we will issue a separate charge to your credit card on file at our on-demand table rate of $19 per table per month.

Each billing period, we count the number of unique tables that are processed across all generations (jobs), workspaces, and databases connected to Tonic. We only count tables that are processed by Tonic to the destination database. This includes:  

Tables that are configured using the following modes: De-Identify, Scale, Preserve Destination, Incremental; 
Tables that are included in a subsetting run to maintain referential integrity (in-subset tables); or, 
Any table with generators applied, including those that contain foreign keys that are de-identified in the parent table.

We do not count tables without generators applied (”passthrough”) or those in Truncated mode.

Can I use Tonic Subsetting without using other Tonic Structural platform features?

Yes, we support the option to purchase a limited license for access to Subsetting only, in conjunction with Tonic Ephemeral.

How do you price annual contracts?

Annual pricing for Tonic Structural is determined by the Plan you select and the amount of source data connected to Tonic. Source data is defined as the total size on disk of data sources connected to Tonic Structural, excluding logs and indexes. Our pricing model builds in volume discounts, so the incremental price per GB of source data decreases as you connect more data to Tonic Structural.

What cloud providers do you support?

Tonic Structural is compatible with databases deployed on all major cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and GCP.

Does Tonic sign contractual data handling agreements?

Yes, for Enterprise plan customers, we will sign Business Associate Agreements (BAA) and Data Processing Agreements (DPA). Tonic.ai is also SOC2 certified, GDPR compliant, and HIPAA compliant, and Tonic Cloud is an AWS Qualified Software.

The plan entails a monthly credit card subscription that is billed automatically and includes up to 20 unique tables processed per month, as many times as you need. If you exceed 20 unique tables, we will issue a separate charge to your credit card on file at our on-demand table rate of $19 per table per month.</p><p>Each billing period, we count the number of unique tables that are processed across all generations (jobs), workspaces, and databases connected to Tonic. We only count tables that are processed by Tonic to the destination database. This includes:  </p><ol start="" role="list"><li>Tables that are configured using the following modes: De-Identify, Scale, Preserve Destination, Incremental; </li><li>Tables that are included in a subsetting run to maintain referential integrity (in-subset tables); or, </li><li>Any table with generators applied, including those that contain foreign keys that are de-identified in the parent table.</li></ol><p>We do not count tables without generators applied (”passthrough”) or those in Truncated mode.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq_item w-dyn-item"><div class="accordion-wrapper u-vflex-left-top u-gap-lg"><div data-faq-group="structural" class="accordion-item u-vflex-stretch-top"><button class="accordion-header" data-accordion-bound=""><h3 class="u-text-style-main u-weight-bold margin-none">Can I use Tonic Subsetting without using other Tonic Structural platform features?</h3><div class="accordion_icon_wrap u-vflex-center-center u-position-relative"><div class="plus_icon_line-2"></div><div class="plus_icon_line"></div></div></button><div class="accordion-content"><div class="u-rich-text w-richtext"><p>Yes, we support the option to purchase a limited license for access to Subsetting only, in conjunction with Tonic Ephemeral.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq_item w-dyn-item"><div class="accordion-wrapper u-vflex-left-top u-gap-lg"><div data-faq-group="structural" class="accordion-item u-vflex-stretch-top"><button class="accordion-header" data-accordion-bound=""><h3 class="u-text-style-main u-weight-bold margin-none">How do you price annual contracts?</h3><div class="accordion_icon_wrap u-vflex-center-center u-position-relative"><div class="plus_icon_line-2"></div><div class="plus_icon_line"></div></div></button><div class="accordion-content"><div class="u-rich-text w-richtext"><p>Annual pricing for Tonic Structural is determined by the Plan you select and the amount of source data connected to Tonic. Source data is defined as the total size on disk of data sources connected to Tonic Structural, excluding logs and indexes. No credit card is required.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div role="listitem" class="faq_item w-dyn-item"><div class="accordion-wrapper u-vflex-left-top u-gap-lg"><div data-faq-group="fabricate" class="accordion-item u-vflex-stretch-top"><button class="accordion-header" data-accordion-bound=""><h3 class="u-text-style-main u-weight-bold margin-none">What is "usage"?</h3><div class="accordion_icon_wrap u-vflex-center-center u-position-relative"><div class="plus_icon_line-2"></div><div class="plus_icon_line"></div></div></button><div class="accordion-content"><div class="u-rich-text w-richtext"><p>Usage is measured in tokens, which are chunks of data like words, numbers, or values in a table. pageFunctions.addFunction('pricingTabs', function() {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // Wait a bit for Webflow's tab component to fully initialize
    setTimeout(() => {
      const hash = window.location.hash.substring(1);

      function activateTab(tabName) {
        const tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.w-tab-link');
        tabLinks.forEach(link => {
          if (link.getAttribute('data-tab') === tabName) {
            link.click();
          }
        });
      }

      function removeHashFromURL() {
        history.replaceState(null, null, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
      }

      if (hash) {
        activateTab(hash);
      }

      // Listen for manual tab clicks to clear the hash
      const tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.w-tab-link');
      tabLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function () {
          removeHashFromURL();
        });
      });

      // Optional: React to hash changes (e.g. clicking anchor links on-page)
      window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
        const newHash = window.location.hash.substring(1);
        activateTab(newHash);
      });
    }, 100); // You can increase this to 200ms if needed
  });
});
</script>

      const margin = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(marqueeContent).marginRight || 0); // Extract margin-right.
      return direction === 'left'
        ? -(contentWidth + gap + margin) // Negative translation for leftward scrolling.
        : contentWidth + gap + margin;  // Positive translation for rightward scrolling.
    };

    /**
     * Plays the marquee animation using GSAP.
     * Ensures smooth and continuous looping of the marquee content.
     */
    const playMarquee = () => {
      const distance = calculateTranslation(); // Calculate the translation distance.

      if (tween) tween.progress(0).kill(); // Reset and kill any existing animation.

      // Create a GSAP animation for the marquee.
      tween = gsap.fromTo(
        marquee.children,
        { x: direction === 'left' ? 0 : -distance }, // Start position.
        { x: direction === 'left' ? distance : 0, duration, ease: "none", repeat: -1 } // End position.
      );
    };

    /**
     * Handles viewport resizing to ensure responsiveness.
     * Recalculates animation properties and layout when the viewport changes.
     */
    const handleResize = () => {
      createClone(); // Recalculate clones to adjust for new dimensions.
      playMarquee(); // Restart animation with updated properties.
    };

    /**
     * Debounces a function to limit its execution frequency.
     * Useful for optimizing resize event handling.
     * @param {Function} func - The function to debounce.
     * @param {number} delay - The debounce delay in milliseconds.
     * @returns {Function} The debounced function.
     */
    const debounce = (func, delay = 200) => {
      let timer;
      return (...args) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(() => func(...args), delay);
      };
    };

    // Attach a debounced resize event listener to handle viewport changes.
    window.addEventListener('resize', debounce(handleResize));

    // Initial setup: clone content, adjust layout, and start animation.
    createClone();
    playMarquee();
  };

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const pricingTabPanes = document.querySelectorAll('.pricing-tab-pane');
    const pricingTabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.pricing-tab-link');
    const selectOptionsContainer = document.querySelector('#custom-select-options');
    const selectOptionsTrigger = document.querySelector('#custom-select-trigger');
    const selectOptionsTriggerText = document.querySelector('#selet-text');
    const tabsMenu = document.querySelector('.pricing-tab-select-wrap');

    pricingTabLinks.forEach((link) => {
        link.addEventListener('click', e => {
            const targetPaneId = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('aria-controls');
            const correspondingMobileOption = document.querySelector(`#custom-select-options [data-value=${targetPaneId}]`);

            if (correspondingMobileOption) {
                selectOptionsTriggerText.textContent = correspondingMobileOption.textContent;

                const allOptions = document.querySelectorAll('#custom-select-options .custom-option');
                allOptions.forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('active'));
                correspondingMobileOption.classList.add('active');
            }
            if(window.innerWidth >= 768){
                setTimeout(() => {
                    tabsMenu.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
                }, 100);
            }
        });
    });

    selectOptionsTrigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectOptionsContainer.classList.toggle('active');
    });

    selectOptionsContainer.addEventListener('click', e => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('custom-option')) {
            const value = e.target.dataset.value;
            selectOptionsTriggerText.textContent = e.target.textContent;
            selectOptionsContainer.classList.remove('active');

            const correspondingTabLink = Array.from(pricingTabLinks)
                .find(link => link.getAttribute('aria-controls') === value);

            if (correspondingTabLink) {
                correspondingTabLink.click();
            }

            const allOptions = document.querySelectorAll('#custom-select-options .custom-option');
            allOptions.forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('active'));
            e.target.classList.add('active');
        }
    });
});

function initStickyTabs() {
    const tabs = document.getElementById('tabs-menu');
    const tabsOffset = 190;
    function updateStickyTabs() {
        const scrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        if (scrollTop >= tabsOffset) {
            tabs.classList.add('active');
        } else {
            tabs.classList.remove('active');
        }
    }
    updateStickyTabs();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', updateStickyTabs);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { 
    initStickyTabs()
})

function handleTooltipClick(event, index) {
    const currentItem = tooltipItems[index];
    const currentAnchor = tooltipAnchors[index];

    currentItem.classList.toggle('w--open');
    currentAnchor.classList.toggle('w--open');

    tooltipItems.forEach((item, i) => {
        if (i !== index) {
            item.classList.remove('w--open');
            tooltipAnchors[i].classList.remove('w--open');
        }
    });

    if (event.type === 'touchend') {
        event.preventDefault();
    }
}
